text:
morgan: Quick intake — request to onboard cormorant-8b for the docs-summarization product flow. Primary goals: match current accuracy, reduce cost via int8, and support hosted + dedicated. Target SLA: p95 < 220ms for 512-token completion and throughput 120 reqs/s on dedicated. Priority: medium, but product wants a fast canary next week.
Tariq: Thanks. Can you paste eval artifacts? We need BLEU/ROUGE/EM/perf on our juicebox prompt set and the large in-house regression suite. Also need quantization delta estimates.
morgan: Uploading quick evals now — baseline (raven-13b baseline) vs cormorant-8b float32: rougeL 0.81 vs 0.79, factuality heuristics ~within noise. Int8 candidate looks promising in perf sims — est memory down 43% and latency down ~30%. Full artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/runs/2026-03-cormorant-8b
anya: Product note — customers using docs-summarization are sensitive to hallucination. If factuality regressions >1.5% we need hold. Also decide hosted rollout cutover plan (shadow -> 5% canary -> 25 -> 100) or dedicate to a new route. Thoughts?
kevin: Runtime notes: cormorant-8b has weird peak KV cache behavior for long context >8k. For 512 tokens it's fine. On A100-80GB: float32 ~6.2GB per replica, int8 ~3.4GB. We can fit 6 replicas on dedicated pool type d-gpu-x. Will recommend int8 with a fallback policy to auk-6b for degraded quality or overload.
ben: Testing plan (QA):
- smoke: basic inference + mux latency
- regression: our 1200 prompt set (dev+prod slices)
- targeted factuality probes (50 prompts)
- embeddings similarity check for rerank (cos sim distributions)

Need to pick acceptance thresholds. Suggest: rougeL drop <=0.03, factuality drop <=1.0% absolute, embedding cosine mean diff <=0.015.
kevin: Agreed. Also add perf SLO: p95 < 220ms hosted low tier (best effort), p99 < 800ms. For dedicated SLA we'll guarantee p95 < 220ms.
sara: Ops/canary checklist draft:
1) Create canary route in hosted with 2 replicas int8, shadow float32 traffic for 24h (compare outputs).
2) Start smoke tests, then run full regression overnight.
3) If regressions within thresholds, do rolling canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with monitoring.
4) Fallbacks: auto-route to auk-6b (lighter) on error rate >2% or latency >1s for 5m.
5) Alerts: regression-alert to #incidents + oncall, quality-alert to product and ml.

Additions?
morgan: Add a private deployment note: customer X wants private VPC + HSM. For private we need to validate model container size with their air-gapped node (4xV100 nodes). Can we produce a minimal container with int8 runtime and small dependency set?
kevin: Yes, we can build a slim image. Will test container size and local smoke. Expect ~2.8GB image extra for int8 libs. Need SE team to confirm HSM env vars.
infra-bot: Capacity check — d-gpu-x pool has 12 free slots for next week, autoscale rules allow 20% burst. Reserved capacity requests will need commit before Friday.
anya: Timeline: aim for shadow start Tuesday, regressions Wed night, canary Thursday if green. Product wants a short notes doc summarizing acceptance thresholds and rollback criteria.
ben: Rollback playbook (for runbook):
- if factuality > threshold OR customer complaints spike: immediate rollback of canary to previous model, start incident triage, collect logs + failed prompts.
- if high latency: scale replicas, if persistent route to auk-6b and open incident.

Include automated dump of KV cache stats and prompt examples in incident report.
kevin: Smoke test commands for eng-runtime team (put in CI):
```
# smoke test
curl -X POST https://api.stage.redwood/models/cormorant-8b:predict \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize the following document...","max_tokens":512}'

# perf harness run
python tools/perf_harness.py --model cormorant-8b --mode int8 --qps 100 --duration 300
```
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started — cormorant-8b-int8 @ hostpool-3 (5% traffic). CI smoke: passed, regression queue started.
sara: I'll hook up the observability dashboard: per-token cost, p95 latency, model quality drift (rouge/fact), error rate. Add log sampling for hallucination cases.
morgan: Thanks all. Action items:
- Tariq: finalize eval artifacts and quality gating spreadsheet.
- Kevin: build slim int8 container and run local smoke.
- Ben: schedule regression run and prepare threshold alerts.
- Sara: create canary route + dashboard + alert policies.
- Anya: write short product acceptance doc.

morgan: Will check in Tue AM to confirm shadow start. Ping me if any blocker. :thumbsup
